parts.problem_md:
$A$ is the point (-2, 1) and $\vec{AB} = ( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 2 \end{gathered} )$.

Find the coordinates of point $B$.
parts.solution_md:
> $\overset{\rightarrow}{AB}$* is the vector from *$A$* to *$B$*, i.e. the difference between *$A$* and *$B$

> *Writing *$A$* as the vector *$( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 2 \end{gathered} )$* and *$B$* as the vector *$( \begin{gathered} x \\ y \end{gathered} )$

$\begin{gathered} \vec{AB} & = ( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 2 \end{gathered} ) = ( \begin{gathered} x \\ y \end{gathered} ) - ( \begin{gathered} - 2 \\ 1 \end{gathered} ) \end{gathered}$

**[M1]**

$\begin{gathered} ( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 2 \end{gathered} ) + ( \begin{gathered} - 2 \\ 1 \end{gathered} ) & = ( \begin{gathered} x \\ y \end{gathered} ) \\ ( \begin{gathered} 2 \\ 3 \end{gathered} ) & = ( \begin{gathered} x \\ y \end{gathered} ) \end{gathered}$

**Final answer:** $B$** is (2, 3)**

**[A1]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> Make sure you give your answer as a coordinate rather than a vector.

parts.problem_md:
$p = ( 3
- 2 ) q = ( - 5
 1 )$

(i) Work out  $p+2q$.

[2]

(ii) $A$is the point $( 2 , 6 )$ and $B$ is the image of point $A$after a translation by the vector $p$. 

Find the coordinates of $B$.

( ...................... , ...................... ) [1]

(iii) Find the magnitude of $q$.

[2]
parts.solution_md:
(i) *Multiply both components of *$q$** ***by 2*

`2 bottom q = ( | 2 x - 5 | | 2 x 1 | | ) = ( | - 10 | | 2 | | )`

**[1]**

> *Add together *$p$* and *$2q$* by adding together corresponding terms*

`bottom p + 2 bottom q = ( | 3 + ( - 10 ) | | - 2 + 2 | | )`

`bottom p + 2 bottom q = stretchy ( | - 7 | | 0 | | stretchy )`** **
**1 mark for each correct number if previous mark not gained**** [2]**

(ii) *The vector *$p = ( 3
- 2 )$* represents a movement of *$3$*units in the *$x$* direction and *$-2$* units in the *$y$* direction*

> $B$* will be 3 unit to the left and 2 units vertically downwards from *$A$

$\begin{gathered} 2 + 3 & = 5 \\ 6 + - 2 & = 4 \end{gathered}$

$( 5 , 4 )$** ****[1]**

(iii) *The magnitude of a vector can be found using the formula*

$\begin{gathered} \left| q \right| & = \sqrt{( - 5 )^{2} + 1^{2}} \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Simplify the expression and use a calculator to write as a decimal.*

$\begin{gathered} \left| q \right| & = \sqrt{25 + 1} = \sqrt{26} \\ = 5.09901... \end{gathered}$

> *Round to 3 significant figures.*

$\text{stretchy} \mid q \text{stretchy} \mid = 5.10$ **[1]**

> *Work out  *$2 ( 2
3 )$*  by multiplying both the top and bottom number in the vector by 2*

$2 \times ( \begin{gathered} 2 \\ 3 \end{gathered} ) = ( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 6 \end{gathered} )$

** ****[1]**

> *Now subtract the second vector from this*

$\begin{gathered} ( \begin{gathered} 4 \\ 6 \end{gathered} ) - ( \begin{gathered} - 3 \\ 5 \end{gathered} ) & = ( \begin{gathered} 4 - - 3 \\ 6 - 5 \end{gathered} ) \end{gathered}$

$( 7 
 1 )$** ****[1]**

parts.problem_md:
Find the magnitude of the vector  $( - 6
 8 )$ .
parts.solution_md:
> *The magnitude of a vector can be found using the formula *

> *Use brackets around negatives*

$\begin{gathered} \left| ( \begin{gathered} - 6 \\ 8 \end{gathered} ) \right| & = \sqrt{( - 6 )^{2} + 8^{2}} \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Simplify the expression*

$\begin{gathered} \left| ( \begin{gathered} - 6 \\ 8 \end{gathered} ) \right| & = \sqrt{36 + 64} \\ = \sqrt{100} \end{gathered}$

$\left| ( - 6
 8 ) \right| = 10$** ****[1]**

$A$ is the point $( 1 , 2 )$ and $\vec{AB} = ( - 1
3 )$.

Find the coordinates of the point $B$.
parts.solution_md:
> *The vector *$\overset{\rightarrow}{AB}$* represents a movement of *$-1$*unit in the *$x$* direction and *$3$* units in the *$y$* direction*

> $B$* will be 1 unit to the left and 3 units vertically upwards from *$A$

$\begin{gathered} 1 - 1 & = 0 \\ 2 + 3 & = 5 \end{gathered}$

$( 0 , 5 )$** ****[2]**
**1 mark for each correct coordinate**

$ma+nb=\text{c}$

Write down two simultaneous equations and solve them to find the value of $m$ and the value of $n$. Show all your working.

$m$ = ................................................     
 $n$ = ................................................
parts.solution_md:
> *Substitute *$a$*, *$b$* and *$c$* into the formula *

$m ( \begin{gathered} - 3 \\ 2 \end{gathered} ) + n ( \begin{gathered} 5 \\ 4 \end{gathered} ) = ( \begin{gathered} 14 \\ 9 \end{gathered} )$

> *Multiply any letters on the outside of a vector by the two numbers inside *

> $( \begin{gathered} - 3 m \\ 2 m \end{gathered} ) + ( \begin{gathered} 5 n \\ 4 n \end{gathered} ) = ( \begin{gathered} 14 \\ 9 \end{gathered} )$* *

> *Add the two vectors on the left (by adding the tops and bottoms separately) *

> $( \begin{gathered} - 3 m + 5 n \\ 2 m + 4 n \end{gathered} ) = ( \begin{gathered} 14 \\ 9 \end{gathered} )$* *

> *Form simultaneous equations (by reading off the top row and the bottom row) *

$\begin{array}{rcl} - 3 m + 5 n & = 14 \\ 2 m + 4 n & = 9 \end{array}$

**[1]**

*These simultaneous equations can be solved by eliminating *$m$*(or *$n$*)* *Make the *$m$* terms equal in size (by multiplying the first equation by 2 and the second equation by 3) *

$\begin{gathered} - 6 m + 10 n & = 28 \\ 6 m + 12 n & = 27 \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

*Add these two equations by adding "like" (similar) terms* *The *$m$* terms should disappear *

> $22n=55$* *

> *Solve this equation for *$n$* (by dividing both sides by 22) *

$n=\frac{55}{22}=\frac{5}{2}$

**[1]**

> *Substitute *$n=\frac{5}{2}$* back into the first equation (or the second) *

$\begin{gathered} - 3 m + 5 \times \frac{5}{2} & = 14 \\ - 3 m + \frac{25}{2} & = 14 \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Solve this equation for *$m$* (for example, by subtracting *$\frac{25}{2}$* from both sides then dividing by *$-3$*) *

$\begin{array}{ccc} - 3 m & = & 14 - \frac{25}{2} \\ - 3 m & = & \frac{3}{2} \\ m = & \frac{\frac{3}{2}}{ - 3} = - 1 \text{half} \end{array}$

> *Check *$m=-\frac{1}{2}$* and *$n=\frac{5}{2}$* satisfy the other equation (*$2m+4n=9$*) by substituting them into the left-hand side *

> $2 \times ( - 1 \frac{1}{2} ) + 4 \times \frac{5}{2} 
= - 1 + 10
= 9$*  *

> *Give both answers together at the end*

$m=-\frac{1}{2}$** ****and**** **$n=\frac{5}{2}$**[1]**
